description: This PHP source file defines a class ADODB2_firebird for handling Firebird database interactions within the ADOdb database abstraction layer. It includes methods for generating SQL statements for creating databases and tables, managing sequences and triggers, quoting identifiers, and altering columns specific to Firebird.

classes.name: ADODB2_firebird
classes.description: A class extending ADODB_DataDict, providing Firebird-specific implementations for database schema management, including creating tables, sequences, triggers, and altering columns.

methods.name: actualType
methods.description: Maps meta types to actual Firebird data types, supporting custom meta types.

methods.name: nameQuote
methods.description: Quotes database identifiers, handling special characters and escaping as needed.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Returns SQL statements to define a new external function for lower-case conversions in Firebird.

methods.name: _dropAutoIncrement
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop sequences used for auto-increment emulation.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Builds additional SQL clauses for column definitions, including DEFAULT, NOT NULL, and constraints.

methods.name: createTableSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to create a table with specified fields and options, including indexes and triggers.

methods.name: _triggers
methods.description: Creates SQL statements for sequences and triggers, used for auto-increment columns in Firebird.

methods.name: alterColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to modify existing columns in a Firebird table.
